notes.title: v1.332 Update details
notes.notes:
After suggestions from this post:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/489020/discussions/0/1319961618835908787/

Some things to take notice of in this update:

- Increase game speed to x10,x15,x20,x30,x40,x50,x100,x250,x500,x1000 unlocked at the equivalent level.

- Quickly select past selected strain or cross strains.

- Tape sound removed

- Store bud right after you click to skip making it faster.

- The potency level is no longer locked to 10.

Happy Growing!
-iDev

notes.title: v 1.245 - a fix patch
notes.notes:
Ok unfortunately I've had a few problems recently. Some how I broke the game in several places from things i've done. So I reverted back to an earlier version on steam.

So I've had to spend some time adding all the latest fixes back in and attempting to fix new problems I've found. I've done a fair bit of testing and everything now seems stable and working like it should.

Like I mentioned before I have been trying to also fix the NaN bug that can happen sometimes. It's basically because the game get's closed while writing to disk. So no data gets saved. So now the game save's less and prompts you when it's saving. Also it won't allow you to exit the game from the menu's when saving. So hopefully unless you close the game from force closing you shouldn't have the NaN error again.

With this new update as well as 50% off during the steam winter sale. It's a great time to get the game and support future development.

If you do experience anything let me know in the forums. As soon as the game is stable I can think about adding more content.

Happy Growing
-iDev

notes.title: New update now available v1.21!
notes.notes:
I've had some great feedback for iGrow Game over the past week. So I set to work on a new update. This is a quick run down of what's new to the game:

Light Height
The lights now automatically change height at certain points of the grow. It doesn't change the gamely in anyway but visually it adds more immersion.

Light Cycles
When the plant's start budding the cycle of the plant changes. This change is so subtle and won't even be noticeable until your able to grow some of the top strains that take longer to grow.

Game difficulty
One of the problems players have found is that it is just too easy to progress through the game. It should now take longer now giving a longer play through.

Crouch
With light movements I decided it would be a good idea to add the ability to crouch while in a room. Making it easier to access plants.

FOV
Field of view was an issue, should look right now.

DOF
Depth of field graphically takes the sharpness away from objects further away. There was none before but it is there now. I haven't added settings for FOV and DOF yet.

Many other minor fixes and changes has happened as well over the past week, including character movement tweaking. This is the beginning of many more updates hopefully. Want to see your suggestions in game then tell me about them on the forums http://forum.igrowgame.co.uk

Happy Growing!

- iDev
